prompt.project_info: Create an intimate soft-light indoor UGC close-up of an approved adult blonde woman in a domestic room.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with fair porcelain-toned skin, long voluminous golden-blonde layered hair and curtain bangs, large grey-blue eyes, soft rosy blush, natural pink lips, and a dreamy relaxed expression. She wears a navy-blue zip-up athletic jacket partly zipped, a delicate gold chain with a small pendant, and dark berry manicure. She leans slightly forward with her left hand gently supporting her cheek and jaw.
prompt.composition_elements: Close-up chest crop, eye-level or slightly above selfie perspective, direct engaging gaze, white door with silver handle on the left, neutral beige walls, and a recessed ceiling light in a softly domestic bedroom or living room.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Large front window provides soft diffused beauty light, even facial illumination, minimal shadows, gentle glow on skin and blonde hair, and a natural quiet indoor mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 30-35mm lens, f/2.8, 1/100s, ISO 200, smartphone-style photorealism, sharp eyes and face with hair/background gently softening, realistic skin and fabric texture, subtle grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an intimate photorealistic indoor UGC close-up of an approved adult woman with fair skin, long voluminous golden-blonde layered hair and curtain bangs, large expressive grey-blue eyes, soft winged eyeliner, defined lashes, subtle rosy blush, natural pink lips, and a soft dreamy relaxed expression. She wears a navy-blue zip-up athletic jacket with a gold zipper partly closed, a delicate gold chain with a small pendant, and dark berry manicure. She sits leaning forward slightly, resting her left cheek and jaw gently on her left hand with relaxed fingers and direct eye contact. Crop at the chest from an eye-level or slightly above 30-35mm selfie perspective, f/2.8, 1/100s, ISO 200. Use a domestic beige-walled room with a white door and silver handle and a recessed ceiling light, illuminated by a large front window with soft diffused beauty light, realistic skin texture, gentle hair detail, and subtle grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, warped fingers, text, logo
